parameters.excerpt: The OF bit is set when the corresponding hpmcounter overflows, and remains set until written by software.
parameters.reasoning: The behavior of the OF bit in response to hpmcounter overflow is implementation-defined, but the outcome is deterministic if software follows the spec rules regarding writing to the OF bit.

parameters.excerpt: If supervisor mode is implemented, the 32-bit scountovf register contains read-only shadow copies of the OF bits in all 29 mhpmevent registers.
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses whether the scountovf register is read-only or not, depending on whether supervisor mode is implemented.
